description: Use centralized RPG Suite genre_filter_dropdown macro in cv6_settings_wrapper
find:
char/setting/{$view} {$selectedGenre.title}{{ phrase('cv6_all_genres') }}
{{ phrase('cv6_all_genres') }} {$genre.setting_count|number} {$genre.title} {$genre.setting_count|number} {$genre.title}
replace:
<xf:macro id="genrefilter" arg-genres="!" arg-selectedGenreId="0" arg-view="list">
	<xf:macro template="public:cv6_rpg_genre_macros" name="genre_filter_dropdown"
		arg-genres="{$genres}"
		arg-route="char/setting/{$view}"
		arg-selectedGenreId="{$selectedGenreId}"
		arg-countField="setting_count" />
</xf:macro>
